mapper.select: SELECT WAG.SHARE_ID AS ROLE_ID, #{empId} AS EMP_ID FROM T_ECC_AUTHORITY_GROUP WAG WHERE WAG.ROLE_ID IN ( SELECT ROLE_ID FROM T_ECC_ROLE_EMP_REL WHERE STAT = 'C' AND EMP_ID = #{empId}) ORDER BY SHARE_ID ASC

select EMPID, ORGID, EMNAME, STAT, TITLENAME, ORGNAME from V_T_SYS_KM_BO_ORMEMBER WHERE EMPID = #{empId} AND ORGNAME = (select * from (SELECT ORGNAME from V_T_SYS_KM_BO_ORMEMBER WHERE EMPID = #{empId} GROUP BY ORGNAME) where rownum = 1)
SELECT ORGID, EMPID, EMNAME FROM V_T_SYS_KM_BO_ORMEMBER WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND STAT = 'STAR'
